shots.title: THE DEAD: a suburban street
shots.caption: Bones lying in the open on a suburb street, bleached and scattered by ten years of scavengers. RUN tab.

shots.title: THE DEAD: the road out
shots.caption: The exodus road. Remains on the asphalt where people stopped walking. RUN tab.

shots.title: THE DEAD: the walk-out
shots.caption: Open desert. The ones who walked out and did not make it, thin and scattered, no mummified bodies because nothing out here is sealed. RUN tab.

shots.title: THE DEAD: how thick they lie
shots.caption: A wider view of the same ground, so the density reads. Too many, too few, or about right is the only call needed. RUN tab.
